blocks.raw: ### **Ability for Existing Users to Change Domicile and Address to Unsupported Country**
blocks.text: Ability for Existing Users to Change Domicile and Address to Unsupported Country

blocks.raw: Existing users can now update their address and domicile to unsupported countries.
blocks.text: Existing users can now update their address and domicile to unsupported countries.

blocks.raw: If an existing user changes to an unsupported country:
blocks.text: If an existing user changes to an unsupported country:

blocks.raw:
* The account `status` will be moved to `OPEN_NO_NEW_TRADES`
* The `closingReason` will be updated to `LEGAL_AML`
* The `statusComment ` will be updated to `Unsupported domicile country`
blocks.text: The account status will be moved to OPEN_NO_NEW_TRADESThe closingReason will be updated to LEGAL_AMLThe statusComment  will be updated to Unsupported domicile country

blocks.raw: A new field `supportDomicile` has been added to the [List Allowed Countries](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/list-all-countries) API to support this change
blocks.text: A new field supportDomicile has been added to the List Allowed Countries API to support this change

blocks.raw: New users will continue to receive an error message if they try to create an account with an unsupported country.
blocks.text: New users will continue to receive an error message if they try to create an account with an unsupported country.

blocks.raw: This change is not applicable to citizenship.
blocks.text: This change is not applicable to citizenship.

blocks.raw:
* `timeInForce` field in notification event for `orders.created` now displays enum value as opposed to numeric value
* Fixed bug where KYC was triggered when not required
* Updated the logic in determining whether an automated wire transfer could be processed
